territories.name: Dominica
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Dominica levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, 2005 (Act 7 of 2005), administered by the Inland Revenue Division: section 9 imposes it on the taxable supply in Dominica of goods or services by a taxable person and on goods and services imported, at 15 per cent, with a rate of 10 per cent for accommodation and for the dive activity of a dive package, a zero rate for the supplies of Schedule I and exemption for those of Schedule II.
